root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `options chrootspec` replaces a previous `$$.runchroot`, the old runchroot pointer must already be absent from `parser_leak_list` before `free($$.runchroot)` runs, so parser cleanup cannot later free that same pointer from a stale `LEAK_PTR` entry.
root_cause_criterion.description: The vulnerable original frees the previous `$$.runchroot` while `parser_leak_list` still contains a matching `LEAK_PTR` entry. The fixed original removes that exact tracker entry first, so the later cleanup walk no longer re-frees the same pointer.

nodes.description: `parser_leak_free()` later reaches `free(entry->u.ptr)` on the stale `LEAK_PTR` entry for the old runchroot pointer, making this call the sanitizer-reported second free.

edges.relation: After `sudoersparse()` frees the old `$$.runchroot` without first removing its `LEAK_PTR` record, `parser_leak_free()` later encounters that same pointer as `entry->u.ptr` and frees it again from parser cleanup.
